data_sources: Live SERP checks via web search on 20 head terms and cluster primaries (August 2026)
Competitor site structure — five Bengaluru solo-consultant sites ranking for the home-market terms
Site inventory read directly from the Astro repo
Category and pricing language pulled from ranking Indian agency pages
confidence: Medium-high on intent and winnability, which are SERP-backed. Low on volume, which is not measured at all.
limitations: No Google Search Console access. Nothing here is ground truth about what the site already ranks for, and the quick-win band is therefore almost empty. Connect GSC and rescore — positions 8 to 25 are the fastest wins on any site and they are invisible right now.
No paid keyword tool. Demand tiers are inferred from phrasing and SERP shape, not from volume data. No volume number appears anywhere in this plan on purpose.
SERP checks ran from a US-located search index. Indian SERPs will differ, particularly on map pack composition and which local agencies rank. Treat city-level winnability as directional.
The 83 parked clusters are parked on a judgment call about what one consultant can credibly service, not on measured difficulty.
